core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghaidaa is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Guide, pathfinder”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghaidaa corresponds to the Arabic form غيداء (Arabic root غ ي د (gh-y-d); غيداء (Ghaydāʾ)). Its core sense is graceful, tender, slender. Ghaidaa (غيداء, Ghaydāʾ) is an Arabic feminine name from the root غ ي د (gh-y-d), describing a young woman who is graceful, soft and slender — a classical poetic image likening her to a young gazelle. The source gloss 'guide, pathfinder' is wrong and has been replaced (it belongs to هدى/دلّ).

persian.name: غیداء
persian.long_meaning: Ghaidaa (غیداء) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن ناز، لطیف است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: غيداء
